d: GraphQL lets clients request exactly the data they need from a single endpoint. It eliminates over-fetching and under-fetching problems of REST. Essential for complex frontends and mobile apps with varying data needs.

p: GraphQL is a query language for APIs that allows clients to request exactly the data they need and nothing more. It solves the 'Over-fetching' and 'Under-fetching' problems of REST.
1. Server defines a strongly typed Schema (Types, Queries, Mutations).
2. Server defines Resolvers (functions to fetch data for fields).
3. Client sends a query specifying exact fields.
4. Server responds with a JSON matching the query shape exactly.

// GraphQL Type Definition
type User {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  posts: [Post]
}
// Client only asks for name, saves bandwidth!

Client Request:                  Server Response:
query {                          {
  user(id: 1) {                    "data": {
    name                             "user": {
    posts { title }                    "name": "Alice",
  }                                    "posts": [{"title": "Hello"}]
}                                    }
                                 }
